mapper.select: SELECT r.status FROM cw_refund r JOIN cw_order o ON o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND CAST(o.user_id AS BINARY) = CAST(#{userId} AS BINARY) AND r.order_id = #{orderId} AND r.type = #{type} ORDER BY r.created_at_ms DESC, r.refund_no DESC LIMIT 1
